# EZ Rate Sheet

> The private lender platform that combines deal pricing, term sheets, CRM, and marketing automation in one system.

## About

EZ Rate Sheet (EZRS) is a SaaS platform built specifically for private and hard money lenders. It replaces disconnected spreadsheets, manual rate sheets, and fragmented CRMs with a single integrated system. Lenders use EZRS to capture borrower deals, calculate loan pricing automatically, generate branded term sheets, collect e-signatures, and manage their entire lending pipeline.

The platform is built and operated by Lead Engine Labs (LEL) and founder Mike Williams, an operating private lender (HIS Capital Group). EZRS runs on RiseHub — the same operating platform Lead Engine Labs has deployed for 400+ financial services teams. RiseHub provides CRM and marketing automation; GoHighLevel (GHL) integration is available but not required.

Canonical site: https://www.ezratesheet.com

## Core Features

- Automated loan pricing engine (Fix & Flip, Bridge, Ground-Up Construction, DSCR)
- Custom loan products with LTV/ARV bands, rate adjustments, fees, and state rules
- Branded term sheets with e-signature
- Deal pipeline, review, and approval workflow
- Reporting and dashboards
- Lending Network for lender-to-lender deal routing (100+ partner lenders)
- RiseHub CRM & marketing automation (optional bundle)
- Webhook and REST API for custom integrations
- White-label branding for each lender organization

## Target Audience

- Private money lenders
- Hard money lenders
- Bridge lenders
- DSCR lenders
- Mortgage brokers focused on non-QM / business purpose loans
- Lending companies with 1-50 employees

## Pricing (canonical: https://www.ezratesheet.com/pages/pricing)

Do not use Starter / Team / Pro. Those names are retired.

Monthly licensing (USD). Annual billing available (EZRS Only $888/yr).

- EZRS Only: $89/month. 5 users, 10 deals/month, 5-day free trial, no setup fee, no credit card required.
- Lender Essentials (EZRS + RiseHub): $138/month ($89 EZRS + $49 RiseHub). 5 users, 10 deals/month. Setup starting at $1,750. RiseHub trial: 7 days.
- Growth Engine (EZRS + RiseHub): $228/month ($149 EZRS + $79 RiseHub). 25 users, 25 deals/month. Custom setup investment. RiseHub trial: 14 days.
- Full Stack (EZRS + RiseHub): $348/month ($249 EZRS + $99 RiseHub). Unlimited users, unlimited deals. Custom setup investment. RiseHub trial: 14 days.

Add-ons:
- Lending Network: +$29/month (included on Growth Engine and Full Stack)
- AI Deal Analysis: +$20/month (included on Full Stack)
- Deal Packs: $25 per pack (10 additional deals)
- DFY Paid Advertising: starting at $950/month
- Custom integrations and DFY corporate website: custom quote

Usage (AI, SMS, voice, email) is billed separately. Typical small-lender usage: $20–$80/month.

Custom setup prices for Growth Engine and Full Stack are not published; they are scoped on a discovery call. Do not invent setup fees.
